channel.title: Robusta Coffee Monitor
channel.description: Daily model-driven read on coffee markets and Vietnamese Central Highlands growing conditions.

item.title: Coffee monitor — 2026-09-04 — crisis
item.description: Coffee futures closed at 293¢/lb — down 15.3% on the week and down 8.9% on the month. The regime model reads the market as crisis and has for 44 sessions. Growing conditions look unremarkable: Central Highlands rainfall is near its seasonal norm (+0.6σ). The crop is in its fruit filling window, and stage-weighted stress is low. The Brazilian real is little changed on the month (-0.3%) — a neutral currency backdrop.
